macro_events.description: NBER declares recession OR two consecutive quarters of negative GDP growth between Q2 2025-Q4 2026
macro_events.impact_on_app: High negative - advertising spend typically declines 10-30% in recessions, directly impacting APP's programmatic advertising revenue

macro_events.description: Any quarter in 2026 showing negative GDP growth
macro_events.impact_on_app: Moderate negative - slower economic growth reduces mobile gaming spend and advertising budgets

macro_events.description: Federal Reserve increases interest rates at any point in 2026
macro_events.impact_on_app: Moderate negative - higher rates reduce growth company valuations and may slow mobile gaming investment

macro_events.description: How high will inflation get in 2026? Market shows 67% odds for >3%
macro_events.impact_on_app: Mixed - higher inflation may reduce consumer discretionary spend but also drives nominal advertising rate increases

macro_events.description: Various markets tracking invasion scenarios and military clashes across different timeframes
macro_events.impact_on_app: High negative - major geopolitical instability would disrupt global advertising markets and mobile gaming supply chains

industry_events.description: Federal legislation including AI training restrictions, usage limits, or human-in-the-loop requirements
industry_events.impact_on_app: Moderate positive - may limit big tech AI advantage, creating opportunities for specialized adtech players like APP

industry_events.description: Bill prohibiting/suspending new AI data center construction approvals in the US
industry_events.impact_on_app: Low impact - APP's business model doesn't require massive data center infrastructure compared to hyperscalers

industry_events.description: General big tech prediction markets exist but specific antitrust enforcement markets limited
industry_events.impact_on_app: Positive if enacted - antitrust breakups of Google/Meta could redistribute advertising market share to independent players

industry_events.description: Found Game Awards 'Best Mobile Game' markets but no industry-wide mobile gaming prediction markets
industry_events.impact_on_app: Limited direct relevance - gaming awards don't correlate strongly with advertising revenue trends

industry_events.description: General advertising prediction markets exist but no specific spending trend forecasts found
industry_events.impact_on_app: Direct relevance - advertising spend is APP's primary revenue driver but prediction markets lack granular coverage

company_specific.description: Will APP report GAAP EPS > $2.95 for Q1 2026? Earnings expected February 11, 2026
company_specific.impact_on_app: Direct - earnings beat/miss immediately impacts stock price and analyst sentiment

company_specific.impact_on_app: Extremely high positive if realized - TikTok acquisition would transform APP into social media giant, but probability appears very low based on trading volume
